steps.name: Package Electron app
steps.run:
npm run example:desktop:package
for attempt in {1..30}; do
  echo "Waiting for the packaged app (attempt ${attempt}/30)"
  if [[ -d examples/universal-app/out ]] &&
    [[ -n "$(find examples/universal-app/out -mindepth 1 -print -quit)" ]]; then
    find examples/universal-app/out -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 -print
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "::error::Desktop package output was not created at examples/universal-app/out"
exit 1

steps.name: Detect drift
steps.run:
# The assignment fails the step when git fails; a test on $(...)
# would read the failure as no drift.
changes="$(git status --porcelain)"
if [[ -n "$changes" ]]; then
  echo "drift=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "Preview images drifted:"
  printf '%s\n' "$changes"
else
  echo "drift=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "Preview images already current."
fi

steps.name: Commit drift back to main
steps.run:
export GH_TOKEN="${RELEASE_PR_TOKEN:-$BUILT_IN_TOKEN}"
# Configure gh as a step-scoped Git credential helper. The checkout
# remains credential-free during dependency installation.
gh auth setup-git
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
# Stage only generated artifacts so unrelated changes can't leak in.
git add -- docs/screenshots/example-app/
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "::notice::No tracked preview-image changes to commit (drift was outside expected paths)."
  git status --porcelain
  exit 0
fi
# Screenshot-only pushes do not match this workflow's path filter.
# Do not add [skip ci]: a fallback PR needs its required checks.
git commit -m "chore(preview): regenerate example-app preview images"
if [[ -n "$RELEASE_PR_TOKEN" ]]; then
  node scripts/push-main-with-rebase-retry.mjs origin main --label preview-images
  echo "landed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
echo "RELEASE_PR_TOKEN is not set: pushing with the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN."
if ! node scripts/push-main-with-rebase-retry.mjs origin main --label preview-images; then
  echo "::error title=Preview images need RELEASE_PR_TOKEN::The preview images changed, but main refused a push with the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN (a ruleset requires a pull request, and pull requests opened by that token do not run checks). Add a fine-grained token with Contents and Pull requests read/write access as the RELEASE_PR_TOKEN secret at $SECRETS_URL and re-run this job, or run 'npm run example:web:preview-images' locally and commit docs/screenshots/example-app/*.png."
  exit 1
fi
echo "landed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Summarize regeneration result
steps.run:
if [[ "$REGENERATE" != "success" ]]; then
  echo "Preview images were not regenerated (step outcome: ${REGENERATE:-not run})."
elif [[ "$DRIFT_OUTCOME" != "success" ]]; then
  echo "Preview drift could not be checked (step outcome: ${DRIFT_OUTCOME:-not run})."
elif [[ "$DRIFT" == "false" ]]; then
  echo "::notice::Preview images are already up to date."
elif [[ "$COMMIT" == "success" && "$LANDED" == "true" ]]; then
  echo "::notice::Regenerated preview images were committed to main."
else
  echo "Regenerated preview images differ but were not committed (commit outcome: ${COMMIT:-not run})."
fi

steps.name: Install pinned lychee with download retries
Check links with lychee
steps.run:
mkdir -p lychee
# Discard a stale report so a CLI error cannot reuse its evidence.
rm -f lychee/out.md
code=0
# Keep research data, Vite-only asset URLs and parser fixtures out
# of the raw file scan, as in the previous action configuration.
lychee --mode task --format markdown --output lychee/out.md \
  --verbose --no-progress --cache --max-cache-age 1d \
  --max-retries 3 --timeout 30 --hidden --extensions md,html \
  --exclude-path docs/case-studies --exclude-path dev/log \
  --exclude-path examples/universal-app/index.html \
  --exclude-path tests/fixtures . || code=$?
echo "exit_code=$code" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [ ! -s lychee/out.md ]; then
  echo "::error title=lychee failed::lychee exited with code $code without writing a report."
  exit 1
fi
cat lychee/out.md
cat lychee/out.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ] && [ "$code" -ne 2 ]; then
  echo "::error title=lychee failed::lychee exited with code $code."
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -Eq 'Total[[:space:]]*\|[[:space:]]*[1-9][0-9]*[[:space:]]*\|' lychee/out.md; then
  echo "::error title=No links checked::Report has no positive Total count. Check the lychee arguments."
  exit 1
fi
# Exit 2 with a report is left to the existing re-check/archive
# diagnostics and final failure step, just as with fail: false.

steps.name: Build and push platform image by digest
Create multi-architecture manifest
steps.run:
# One argument per digest. An array keeps the expansion explicit
# instead of relying on word splitting of a command substitution.
mapfile -t digests < <(printf "${IMAGE}@sha256:%s\n" *)
if [[ "${#digests[@]}" -ne 2 ]]; then
  echo "Expected 2 platform digests, found ${#digests[@]}." >&2
  exit 1
fi
docker buildx imagetools create \
  --tag "${IMAGE}:latest" \
  --tag "${IMAGE}:${VERSION}" \
  "${digests[@]}"

steps.name: Verify published multi-architecture manifests
steps.run:
for tag in latest "${VERSION}"; do
  if ! manifest="$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "${IMAGE}:${tag}")"; then
    echo "Unable to read back published manifest ${IMAGE}:${tag}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  for platform in linux/amd64 linux/arm64; do
    if ! grep -Eq "Platform:[[:space:]]+${platform}" <<<"${manifest}"; then
      echo "Published manifest ${IMAGE}:${tag} is missing ${platform}" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done
